title: 2012 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: Jamar bought some pencils costing more than a penny each at the school bookstore and paid \(\$1.43.\) Sharona bought some of the same pencils and paid \(\$1.87.\) How many more pencils did Sharona buy than Jamar?

solutions.text:
Let \(c\) be the price of one pencil in cents. Then \(c\) divides both \(143\) and \(187\), and \(c\gt1\).

Since \(143=11\cdot13\) and \(187=11\cdot17\), the greatest common divisor is \(11\). Thus each pencil costs \(11\) cents.

Sharona paid \(187-143=44\) cents more, so she bought \(\frac{44}{11}=4\) more pencils. Thus, the answer is C .
hints: The pencil price in cents divides both \(143\) and \(187\).
Use the greatest common divisor of \(143\) and \(187\).
